key_finding: Unit = request_id and pod (browser session), not job. In scan-worker the login step itself logs 'final url after redirections: <login URL>' (ulta 77d15816: 146 interaction starts vs 150 /u/login landings, 0 failed requests), so counting login landings per job over-calls B5. Also: 'element: X, exists: true' is followed by 'No element found for selector: X' within 13-160 ms in all 5 selector failures examined, so 'exists: true' does not mean the selector works.

rules.check: Does the job run a login/interaction at all ('starting page interaction plugin')? Without it, login/verify-login landings are gated pages/scope (C4), not B.
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'starting page interaction plugin' | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate count() as starts, approx_count_distinct($d.context.request_id) as reqs
rules.outcome_if_true: continue to step 1 (else → not B; C4/scope)
rules.evidence: enrollnow a00b1cce, paieb, salesforce/heroku blog links, argos/booking sign-in links: login landings with no interaction

rules.check: On the interaction request, a [browser] 'Failed to load resource ... status of 403/405' appears between 'going to URL: <login url>' and the first 'final url after redirections' (or net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET)
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] == '<JOB>' && ($d.message ~ 'starting page interaction plugin' || $d.message ~ 'going to URL' || $d.message ~ 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of' || $d.message ~ 'final url after redirections') | create mt from substr($d.message:string, 0, 120) | groupby $d.context.request_id as rid, mt aggregate min($m.timestamp) as t, count() as n | orderby rid, t
rules.outcome_if_true: → A1 (bot/WAF block) even if the terminal error is 'No element found for selector'
rules.evidence: #3301 crawl 601e87c1 (405 at +180 ms); absent on spectrum 2c241337/b3984da6 and Chick-fil-A 770c499d (true B2)

rules.check: error.message contains "is not a valid selector"
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'encountered error while running a function with timeout' && $d.error.message:string ~ 'is not a valid selector' | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate count() as n, any_value(substr($d.error.message:string,0,300)) as sample

rules.check: Interaction error JSON: message 'No element found for selector: X', error.url = the login/interaction page; last logged step = TYPE_TEXT/CLICK on X (exists: true just before). X generated-looking (':R..:', 'kite-label-input-N', 'sc-xxxx' classes, nth-child)
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'encountered error while running a function with timeout' && $d.error.message:string ~ 'No element found for selector' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | extract $d.ej.url:string into $d.b using regexp(e=/^(?<base>https?:\/\/[^?#]+)/) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job, $d.ej.message:string as msg, $d.b.base:string as browser_url aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.context.request_id) as reqs | orderby n desc
rules.evidence: #3198 Chick-fil-A 770c499d/8717415b (sc- class CLICK), spectrum 2c241337/b3984da6 (kite-label-input-3/4), cigna 634a92b2 (#username, slow SPA)

rules.check: Failure at the second step of an identifier-first flow: username typed, then the Continue click / password field fails; error.url is the IdP (accounts.*, id.*, /u/login/identifier)
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] == '<JOB>' && !($d.message ~ 'config is') && !($d.message ~ 'received message') | create mt from substr($d.message:string, 0, 140) | create em from substr($d.error.message:string, 0, 260) | groupby $d.context.request_id as rid, mt, em aggregate count() as n, min($m.timestamp) as t | orderby t
rules.outcome_if_true: → B4 (needs multi-interaction config), B2 if the Continue selector is positional/stale
rules.evidence: zalando crawl ca8b7ff9 (username → sleep 20 → nth-child button click fails); 1 job

rules.check: Interaction request logs all steps + 'finished interacting with page successfully', and the request's next final URL / 'successfully scraped url. final url' is still the login path; same in every pod/request
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && ($d.message ~ 'final url after redirections' || $d.message ~ 'starting page interaction plugin' || $d.message ~ 'clicking element' || $d.message ~ 'No element found for selector') | extract $d.message into $d.fu using regexp(e=/redirections: (?<u>https?:\/\/[^?#\s]+)/) | create lg1 from if($d.message ~ 'final url' && $d.fu.u:string.matches(/(?i)(login|signin|sign-in|logon|authenticate|\/sso|\/guest$|\/auth\/)/), 1, 0) | create nm1 from if($d.message ~ 'final url' && lg1 == 0, 1, 0) | create st1 from if($d.message ~ 'starting page', 1, 0) | create ck1 from if($d.message ~ 'clicking element', 1, 0) | create nf1 from if($d.message ~ 'No element found', 1, 0) | groupby $l.subsystemname as sub, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job, $d.context.request_id as rid aggregate sum(lg1) as lg, sum(nm1) as nm, sum(st1) as st, sum(ck1) as ck, sum(nf1) as nf, any_value($d.fu.u) as u | create cls from if(st > 0 && nf > 0, 'selector_fail', if(st > 0 && ck > 0 && nm == 0 && lg > 0, 'submitted_still_on_login', if(st > 0 && nm > 0, 'login_ok', if(st == 0 && lg > 0 && nm == 0, 'bounced_no_login', if(st > 0, 'login_other', 'plain'))))) | filter cls != 'plain' | groupby sub, job, cls aggregate count() as reqs, any_value(u) as sample | orderby job
rules.outcome_if_true: → B3 (stale/invalid credentials or lockout); rule out A1 (step 1) and B1 (MFA on same SPA route)
rules.evidence: dealernavigator scan 2e285067 + crawl 997debb0 (job DONE with 1 page = login page); 403s on first load keep A1 open

rules.check: Request that clicked submit ends on a path containing mfa|otp|2fa|verify|challenge|step-up|passcode (path only, not query string)
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'final url after redirections' && $d.message:string.matches(/(?i)redirections: https?:\/\/[^?#\s]*(mfa|otp|2fa|two-?factor|verify|verification|challenge|step-?up|passcode|one-time)/) && !($d.message ~ '/tag/') && !($d.message ~ '/blog') | extract $d.message into $d.fu using regexp(e=/redirections: (?<u>https?:\/\/[^?#\s]+)/) | groupby $d.fu.u as landing aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']) as jobs, any_value($d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']) as job | orderby n desc
rules.evidence: 0 cases in 7 days (only login-less verify-login/step-up-auth deep links and content pages)

rules.check: Per pod (browser session): first request login_ok, later requests of the SAME pod land on the login URL and keep doing so, while other pods succeed on neighbouring URLs
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] == '<JOB>' && ($d.message ~ 'final url after redirections' || $d.message ~ 'starting page interaction plugin' || $d.message ~ 'finished interacting with page') | extract $d.message into $d.fu using regexp(e=/redirections: (?<u>https?:\/\/[^?#\s]+)/) | create lg1 from if($d.message ~ 'final url' && $d.fu.u:string.matches(/(?i)(login|signin|authenticate|\/sso)/), 1, 0) | create nm1 from if($d.message ~ 'final url' && lg1 == 0, 1, 0) | create st1 from if($d.message ~ 'starting page', 1, 0) | create pod from $d.resource.attributes['k8s.pod.name']:string | groupby $d.context.request_id as rid aggregate min($m.timestamp) as t0, any_value(pod) as pod, any_value($d.context.url) as url, sum(lg1) as lg, sum(nm1) as nm, sum(st1) as st | orderby pod, t0
rules.outcome_if_true: → B5 (session lost mid-crawl). If bounces are per URL family in every pod and the next request succeeds → gated pages (C4/permissions), not B5
rules.evidence: B5: evernorth scan 33a804f5 pod -grk8c (5/5 later requests → /u/login/identifier). Not-B5: snr.bell.ca 8e66ad07/e87505a5 (USER_* folders bounce in all 6 pods, not sticky); ulta 77d15816 (landings = the login step)

rules.check: 'bound handleRequest execution took more than 300000 miliseconds'
rules.query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'encountered error while running a function with timeout' && $d.error.message:string ~ 'handleRequest execution took more than 300000' | groupby $l.subsystemname as sub, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name'] as job aggregate count() as n, min($m.timestamp) as t0 | orderby n desc
rules.outcome_if_true: → only 'request budget exhausted' — read steps 1–5 for the cause; not a B4 marker
rules.evidence: 26 jobs/7d; top-10: 3 with login (cigna x2 selector failure + slow page, ulta OK), 7 login-less heavy sites (D1)

still_ambiguous.why: Browser stays on the login route after a 'successful' interaction; SPA MFA screens can share the route and 403s on first load (dealernavigator) also fit A1. No post-submit page text/title is logged.
Identifier-first IdPs (zalando): positional Continue selector fails after username; 400 resource errors on load; cannot tell element missing vs not-yet-rendered vs blocked.
With a single pod there is no sibling session to compare; rely on stickiness (all later requests bounce) vs per-URL bounces.
Step trace is identical (exists:true → action → No element found); only the 403/405 resource line on the interaction request separates them, and it is Info-level and easy to miss.

found_in_dom vs visible vs detached, DOM snippet or screenshot path at failure, frame list

logging_gaps.where: crawl-worker/scan-worker 'bound handleRequest execution took more than 300000'
